page_title: ATA 2-0 GEN | Atalanta v Genoa 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Livio Marinelli to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Atalanta players can finally celebrate.
90+7' Mattia Bani (Genoa) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Livio Marinelli lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Atalanta players aren’t happy.

90+6' 2 - 0 Goal! Mario Pasalic displays great vision and sends a pass to Ederson (Atalanta), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:0.

90+4' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick. Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and it's Mattia Bani (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
90+3' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Caleb Ekuban is replaced by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa).

90+3' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Genoa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davide Zappacosta trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Livio Marinelli had an easy-decision to make.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Matteo Ruggeri.
87' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Seydou Fini (Genoa) replaces Stefano Sabelli.
86' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) gets a yellow card, off the field.
83' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Ruslan Malinovsky and he is replaced by George Puscas (Genoa).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Galdames (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Morten Thorsby can be given a rest.
81' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

80' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' Here is a change. Gianluca Scamacca is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
79' Substitution. Ademola Lookman walks off the pitch and Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.

77' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
77' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
74' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' No handball! Referee Livio Marinelli points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Atalanta players celebrate.
70' The Atalanta players joy may have been justified, because referee Livio Marinelli is going use VAR to determine whether there was a handball.
69' The Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Livio Marinelli rules it out for a handball.
67' Mattia Bani (Genoa) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
66' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' The game is interrupted. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
64' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
63' The ball is cleared after Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atalanta have a corner.

62' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save to stop his effort.
60' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Genoa have a free kick.
56' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
56' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick to Atalanta.

55' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
53' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Livio Marinelli ignores the protests.
53' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) trips an opposition player and Livio Marinelli signals a foul. Genoa win a free kick.
51' The foul by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Genoa earn a free kick.

50' Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

48' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
48' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

48' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Nicola Leali is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
47' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Aleksey Miranchuk has come on in place of Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
42' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) commits a foul and Livio Marinelli immediately signals a free kick. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
39' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) works the corner short.
39' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.

38' Nicola Leali was forced into action to thwart Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.

37' Stefano Sabelli sprays a pass out to Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
34' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Genoa.
31' Livio Marinelli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta). Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
30' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
29' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gathers a rebound, beats his marker and goes for goal from distance, but one of his own teammates inadvertently blocks the effort. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
29' Ederson (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

29' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Nicola Leali has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
27' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Nicola Leali comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
25' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
23' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Genoa get a free kick.

22' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atalanta are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
15' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' An attempted cross from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared. Atalanta earn a corner.
14' A quickly taken corner by Atalanta.
13' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off the line to clear the ball away.
11' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
6' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Marco Carnesecchi.

5' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement. Genoa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atalanta will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Livio Marinelli.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
